description.value: True North Distilleries is BC's first female-owned and operated craft distillery, producing a range of low-oak whiskeys (Irish, Scottish, Canadian, and American styles), full-bodied gins, absinthes, and award-winning liqueurs. Visitors can book guided Whiskey or Absinthe tasting experiences, and the Barrel Buyers Club lets enthusiasts purchase a share in a full aging barrel with a personalised boutique label at maturity. The distillery is located in Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island.
